title: Wikipedia collective intelligence
summary: Wales and Pentland converge: collective intelligence emerges when individual contribution, platform technology and community norms coordinate. A bad edit is tracked, noticed and reverted, which improves both the content and the norms; low barriers and good norms sustain participation.

nodes.label: Community Norms
nodes.description: NPOV, assume good faith, dispute resolution

nodes.label: Platform Affordances
nodes.description: Wiki software, edit history, discussion pages

edges.description: Low barriers and transparent history make contribution possible
Norms and reverts suppress bad edits
Disputes resolved well improve the norms as well as the content
Norms recruit and retain good-faith editors

identifiability_note: Community norms (n4) act on both contributors and vandalism pressure; isolating the platform effect on quality requires holding norm strength fixed, which is not observed directly.
